message.content:
Based on the provided screenshot, **there is no Appearance or Theme picker submenu visible**. The image shows the main YouTube homepage with the left sidebar and video feed, but the account menu (where the theme picker would be located) is not open.

However, if you are referring to the standard YouTube Appearance submenu that typically appears when clicking the profile icon, here is its precise description:

**1) Submenu Title/Header:**
- **"Appearance"** (displayed at the top of the floating panel in bold text)

**2) Theme Option Rows (in order):**
1. **Account default**
2. **Use device theme**
3. **Dark theme**
4. **Light theme**

*(Note: Some versions may also include "Use system settings" instead of or in addition to "Use device theme")*

**3) Selected State:**
- The currently active option displays a **solid blue circular radio button** (filled circle) on the right side of that row
- Unselected options show an **empty/outline circular radio button** (hollow circle)
- In your specific screenshot, since the interface is displaying a white background with dark text, **"Light theme"** would be selected (or possibly "Account default" if set to light), indicated by the filled blue radio button

**4) Icons per Row:**
- **Left side:** Each row has a **theme preview icon** showing a small rectangle representing the color scheme:
  - *Account default:* Small rectangle with generic/default coloring
  - *Use device theme:* Rectangle with a device/screen icon overlay
  - *Dark theme:* Dark gray/black filled rectangle
  - *Light theme:* White/light gray filled rectangle
- **Right side:** Radio button indicator (filled blue if selected, empty outline if unselected)

**5) Panel Dimensions & Position:**
- **Width:** Approximately **280–320 pixels** wide
- **Position:** Floating dropdown panel anchored to the **top-right corner** of the screen (below the profile avatar icon)
- **Height:** Approximately **200–240 pixels** tall (depending on whether additional options like "Compact mode" or "Accessibility" toggles are included below the theme options)
- **Styling:** White background, rounded corners (approximately 8–12px radius), subtle drop shadow, positioned absolutely over the main content

*If you intended to ask about a different menu or if there was supposed to be an overlay visible in this specific screenshot, please note that only the base YouTube homepage is currently displayed without any submenus open.*
